name: Multi-view Anchor Aggregation and Local Decoding
aliases: Anchor-based Multi-view Aggregation with Local Gaussian Decoding
definition: A process where each 3D anchor aggregates visual features from all input views using occlusion-aware weighting, exchanges information with other anchors via self-attention, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussian primitives.
summary: Multi-view Anchor Aggregation and Local Decoding aggregates multi-view features into compact 3D Gaussians using spatial anchors, solving incomplete geometry reconstruction in occluded regions unlike pixel-aligned methods.
